summary: 4gaboards: a self-hosted Kanban board app (WeKan fork) on Sails.js/Waterline over PostgreSQL — users, auth (password+SSO+API clients+mail tokens), projects, boards, lists, cards, tasks, comments, attachments, labels, memberships, activity log, notifications, and an archive system; board membership roles (editor/viewer) gate board mutations.
